name: AI chatbot evaluator and writer (DataAnnotation)
summary: Online platform that pays contributors to rate chatbot answers, write and check code for AI training, paid via PayPal.
whatYouDo: After passing a starter assessment, you choose from available projects such as rating or comparing chatbot answers, writing prompts or checking code. Work is self-paced with no minimum hours.
appeal: Official FAQ lists general projects from about $25/hr, multilingual from $20/hr, and coding/STEM from $40/hr
No minimum hours and no sign-up fee (official pages)
Paid via PayPal, with deposits a few days after you request them (official FAQ)
Company pages carry a testimonial from a Canadian worker
watchOuts: No official country list is published; Canada appears only in third-party lists and testimonials
Applicants who are not accepted often hear nothing back after the starter assessment (blog reports)
Reviews describe work 'droughts' and account bans
Pay ranges are company marketing figures that differ between pages; currency was not shown in what we saw
Scammers impersonate the brand; the company says it never asks workers for money

credentials: bachelor's degree may qualify for the general tier (FAQ); advanced degrees or licences for STEM/professional tiers

training.notes: A starter assessment is required; whether it is paid was not evidenced in sources seen.

compensation.notes: Official FAQ/role pages: multilingual from $20+/hr; general chatbot evaluation $25–50+/hr; coding $40–150+/hr; STEM/professional $40–125+/hr. Pages disagree slightly; currency not stated in the snippets (likely USD, unverified).

reliability.notes: Blogs report silent rejections, work droughts and bans; no official statement on volume. Anecdotal.

applicationSteps: Sign up on the DataAnnotation site
Complete the starter assessment (plus any specialist assessments)
Wait for acceptance; blogs say replies take 1–4 weeks or never come
Link a PayPal account and choose projects from your dashboard
fitsIf: You write well, are comfortable with self-paced online work, and can treat it as a bonus if you are accepted.
notFitIf: You need a clear yes/no on acceptance or a dependable weekly income.
